events.address: Vanderbilt Hall, Grand Central Terminal, 89 E 42nd St, New York, NY 10017
events.what_it_is: A Tatcha skin-and-mind pop-up at Vanderbilt Hall with product discovery, self-guided meditation and limited guided meditation sessions.
events.what_is_free: Pop-up access, product discovery and samples; self-guided meditation spots are available by reservation or first-come, first-served. Guided meditation sessions require reserving a limited spot.
events.caveats: The guided 10-minute meditation sessions have limited capacity and should be reserved. The broader self-guided experience is also available first-come, first-served. Do not imply that an RSVP guarantees every activity.
events.practical_notes: Monday Sept. 21: 9 AM–7 PM. Tuesday Sept. 22: 8 AM–7 PM. Vanderbilt Hall inside Grand Central Terminal.

events.event_name: Light Hill: Art into Action Educational Gallery
events.brand: Light Hill Collaborative × Climate Week NYC
events.what_it_is: A Climate Week NYC educational gallery pop-up featuring thirteen original works by twelve artists exploring methane pollution through art, data and action.
events.what_is_free: The week-long gallery is free and open to the public.
events.caveats: Climate Week NYC identifies this as a public event and links to registration. The official listing states the gallery itself is free and open to the public; registration is the advertised advance action.
events.practical_notes: Open daily Sept. 21–27, 11 AM–6 PM, at 74 Franklin Street.

events.what_it_is: An immersive public activation for Valentino Beauty's Vendetta fragrance launch at Gansevoort Plaza.
events.what_is_free: Public access to the fragrance-launch activation; no purchase requirement is published.
events.caveats: Current event coverage explicitly says the activation is open to the public and does not publish an advance RSVP requirement. Normal capacity rules may still apply.
events.practical_notes: Friday Sept. 25 and Saturday Sept. 26, noon–7 PM, at Gansevoort Plaza under the High Line.

events.event_name: A Taste of Grand Bazaar at Industry City
events.address: Industry City Courtyard 3/4, 237 36th St, Brooklyn, NY 11232
events.what_it_is: A one-day Grand Bazaar NYC pop-up at Industry City with independent vendors, makers, artists and vintage dealers.
events.what_is_free: Admission to browse the market is free; merchandise and food are sold separately.
events.caveats: Grand Bazaar NYC links directly to an Eventbrite RSVP from its official event page. Purchases from vendors are optional and separate from admission.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 26, 11 AM–6 PM. Courtyard 3/4 at Industry City; enter from 36th Street and follow signs toward Buildings 3 and 4.
